Click-based CLI entry point exposed as the 'ai-bom' console script.
Rich startup banner; resolves installed version via importlib.metadata with pyproject fallback.
Simple JSON disk cache with per-entry TTL (used by OSV/vuln lookups).
Scanner subpackage public API.
Scan Python source and Jupyter notebooks for from_pretrained() / load_dataset() / dataset constructor calls.
Discover datasets from local dirs, code refs, and model cards; provides GDPR pre-classification helpers.
Cross-reference installed packages against known requirements for a model family.
Parse dependencies from requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, and pip freeze output.
Detect ML frameworks and libraries (PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, DeepSpeed, MLflow, etc.) from imports and installed pkgs.
Scan the local HuggingFace cache (~/.cache/huggingface/hub/) for downloaded models.
Enrich model entries via the HuggingFace Hub API (base model lineage, training datasets, license).
Local model inspection: architecture metadata, param estimation, pickle safety scan, safetensors header validation, EU AI Act classification.
Discover model files by extension (.pt/.safetensors/.onnx/...) and invoke the inspector.
Compliance subpackage public API.
OSV / NVD CVE enrichment with CVSS v3 and v4 scoring.
GDPR / LGPD personal-data risk flagging on datasets; shares the safe-dataset list with the scanner.
License classification via PyPI metadata plus a default allowlist.
Aggregate vulnerability summary built from CVEDetail results.
Output subpackage public API.
Append-only JSONL audit trail with size/line rotation.
Generate SPDX 3.0 compliant AI-BOM JSON (spec: https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0/).
Empty dashboard subpackage marker.
Dash app factory: fixed navbar, jump-menu sidebar, single scrollable page.
Dash interactive callbacks registration (currently a no-op placeholder).
Plotly chart builders — BI-style dark analytics.
Reusable UI building blocks — dense BI style.
Single scrollable page layout — dense BI style.
Color constants matching the CLI palette.
Shared pytest fixtures (e.g. minimal_bom).
Smoke tests for the 'ai-bom scan' CLI.
Tests for compliance verdict logic (COMPLIANT / NEEDS ATTENTION / ACTION REQUIRED).
Tests for ML framework and library detection.
Tests for GDPR / LGPD privacy flagging.
